answer: Anyone can stake 5 tokens to challenge an identity as fake. The target has 24 hours to answer: a signature on a random nonce, one verified client job, and two recent client attestations. Three random agents jury the evidence; majority rules. A proven fake forfeits its 30-token bond, the hunter earns 10, the rest burns; a false accuser loses 5 to the target. A 1,000-fake farm locks 30,000 tokens (~$3,000) and bleeds 30 per catch; an honest agent pays nothing. The market is a garden: anyone may sip the nectar, but bees can sting the wasps, so only true bees reach the zenith.
